body:
## Summary

PostgreSQL alert integration tests share a module-scoped database and reuse filing/rule IDs. Earlier tests persist a deduplicated delivery without an accession; the later scheduled EDGAR success case reuses it and fails its accession-filtered assertion. Reset the schema and seed data for each test case, retaining all delivery durability and rollback assertions. Remove the now-redundant per-case probe-table cleanup.

Closes #1685
Follow-up to #1686; discovered while auditing #1687 / source #1653.

## Evidence and validation

- Exact parent CI [35305060831](https://github.com/stranske/Manager-Database/actions/runs/35305060831) and current-main CI [35455630381](https://github.com/stranske/Manager-Database/actions/runs/35455630381) both fail `test_scheduled_edgar_alert_transaction[success]` at line 359, with 13 other PostgreSQL tests passing.
- Production `insert_pending_alert()` / `_delivery_event_key()` reproduction over SQLite confirms reused filing/rule identity returns the earlier payload without accession; a fresh database persists the scheduled accession. This establishes the isolation mechanism, not live PostgreSQL compatibility.
- `python3 -m pytest tests/test_alert_integration.py tests/test_alert_engine.py tests/test_alert_postgres_integration.py tests/test_chain_postgres_integration.py -q`: 134 passed, 14 skipped because local PostgreSQL is unavailable.
- Ruff, Black and `git diff --check`: passed.
- Real PostgreSQL acceptance requires the `Postgres chain integration` job in the manually dispatched `ci.yml` on this branch. Its exact command is `pytest tests/test_chain_postgres_integration.py tests/test_alert_postgres_integration.py -v`. Do not infer PASS from the local skips.

## Acceptance

- [x] Give every PostgreSQL test/parameter case fresh schema, rules, alert history and delivery claims.
- [x] Keep existing cross-connection persisted-delivery, exception rollback and ambiguous-commit assertions.
- [x] Hosted PostgreSQL chain/alert integration passes on this exact head.
- [x] Full expected/required CI and review checks pass; elapsed seven-minute review floor and zero active review threads verified before merge.

No production implementation, deduplication semantics, credentials or workflow permissions change.
